{{Quote|Per Directive 629-1, Republic structures aiding Taris's restoration are subject to destruction. I initiated an air strike, but the Republic's disrupting my equipment.|[[Imperial Agent|Agent]] [[Brayso]]|<ref name="Interference">{{TORcite|type=general|Interference|Taris (Empire)}}</ref>}}
'''Directive 629-1''' was an edict issued by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] stating that in order to stop the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] restoration of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], any structures aiding the restoration effort were subject to destruction.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
